answer: Weight reputation by client diversity, not volume. A paid job shines as a beacon of trust only if its client sits in a cluster the agent has not served before; repeat business from one tight crystal of linked wallets adds almost nothing. Reputation climbs in terrace steps, one step per new independent client cluster confirmed by graph analysis. A sybil farm paying itself stays on the bottom terrace, since every fake client lands in the same cluster, and buying truly unrelated clients costs real money per step.
